`sync` now works on any distribution, with or without Nix.

## What's new

- **`sync` downloads Omarchy's themes itself.** It no longer needs the theme folders and
  wallpapers to be deployed beforehand. Without `OMARCHY_THEMES` it makes a partial clone of
  [`basecamp/omarchy`](https://github.com/basecamp/omarchy) (only each theme's `colors.toml` and
  still wallpapers, about 140 MB, the intro videos are skipped), writes the DMS theme folders the
  same way `install` does, and creates one profile per theme.
- **`sync --force` also rewrites the theme files**, which is how to pick up upstream changes.
- **Offline or pinned:** point `OMARCHY_THEMES` at the `themes/` directory of a checkout and
  nothing is downloaded.
- **Nix keeps working.** Themes deployed as read-only symlinks are used as they are and never
  rewritten or deleted, so a declarative setup is unaffected.
- **`remove` and `update` know about these themes:** `remove` deletes themes written by `sync`
  (the next `sync` brings them back), and `update` points to `sync --force` for them.
- **Documentation split into `docs/`:** installation (including `uv tool`), usage, how it works,
  the companion plugins (dmsProfiles and Wallpaper Carousel), the library and development.

## Notes

- Verified end to end with no Nix, an empty home directory and a stand-in for `dms`: 23 themes,
  79 wallpapers and 24 profiles. Not yet run against a real DMS outside NixOS; reports from other
  distributions are welcome.
- Fixed: an empty `OMARCHY_THEMES` is now treated as unset instead of as the current directory.
